title: A Secret Plan Forms Around Dileram's Chest

blocks.text: After resisting for a time, Jassa Singh chalked out a strategy that would let the Ramgharias keep the finest treasure out of Ghanaiya hands. The first step is secrecy: those who know the chest's value must be controlled before the wider Khalsa can demand an open accounting.

Maali Singh accordingly removes the prized box from Dileram's old house and transfers it into his own camp, but concealment proves harder than seizure. Rumour spreads, tempers flare, and the allied camp fills with accusation as both sides suspect that the richest find has been withheld.

When Charat Singh insists that Dileram himself be questioned, the conspirators recognize the danger of truthful testimony. The page thus shifts from hidden theft to the darker question of how witnesses will be silenced.
